maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded detection-gap analysis and ATT&CK-based SOC assessment support professional assessment knowledge. The two-year profile and absent practical detail make this weaker evidence of live response execution than a hands-on analyst exam.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded ATT&CK coverage-gap analysis is relevant to SOC improvement at a two-year level. Without an explicit practical assessment in this record, I retain associate below the professional source hint.
